Founded in 1985, IESA is one of the oldest institutions for arts management and cultural studies in France.

For more than three decades, IESA Arts and Culture has inspired and created many cultural leaders and arts professionals.

Student Life

IESA Arts and Culture was founded in 1985 as the European Institute of Art Sciences in Paris.

The institution stands as a centre of excellence in arts education and cultural management. The institution offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, attracting students from around the world.

At IESA Arts and Culture, students work with partner organisations and industry professionals in the field.

Why IESA Arts and Culture?

  • With a faculty of experienced industry professionals, IESA provides hands-on training to students.
  • The institution's alumni and industry connections provide support and opportunities for graduates as they navigate their professional journeys.
  • IESA also collaborates with leading industry professionals within the entertainment industry.
